{{Top|leg}}
The '''Pangalactic Championship''' was a [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxing]] tournament. [[Lobar Aybock]] was projected to be the top contender for the championship in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. Many years later, a few wealthy figures founded the Pangalactic Shockboxing Federation (PSF), which began to build up the sport around the galaxy especially within the Mid and Outer Rim.
